t: 英国查理一世于2月所发的文字授权英格兰的每个郡(不仅仅是海港城镇)在此日期前缴纳船舶税.
te: Writs issued in February by Charles I of England mandate that every county in England (not just seaport towns) pay ship…
dz: 英国查理一世于2月所发的文字授权英格兰的每个郡(不仅仅是海港城镇)在此日期前缴纳船舶税.
de: Writs issued in February by Charles I of England mandate that every county in England (not just seaport towns) pay ship tax by this date.

t: 马萨诸塞湾殖民地获得皇家特许状。
te: The Massachusetts Bay Colony is granted a Royal charter.
dz: 马萨诸塞湾殖民地获得皇家特许状。
de: The Massachusetts Bay Colony is granted a Royal charter.

t: 《权利请愿书》是一份主要的英国宪法文件,得到查理一世的御准,成为法律.
te: The Petition of Right, a major English constitutional document, is granted royal assent by Charles I and becomes law.
dz: 《权利请愿书》是一份主要的英国宪法文件,得到查理一世的御准,成为法律.
de: The Petition of Right, a major English constitutional document, is granted royal assent by Charles I and becomes law.

t: 瑞典战列舰瓦萨号 在斯德哥尔摩出海时沉没.
te: The Swedish warship Vasa sinks on her maiden voyage off Stockholm.
dz: 瑞典战列舰瓦萨号 在斯德哥尔摩出海时沉没.
de: The Swedish warship Vasa sinks on her maiden voyage off Stockholm.

t: 第一位白金汉公爵乔治·维利耶斯被约翰·费尔顿刺杀.
te: George Villiers, the first Duke of Buckingham, is assassinated by John Felton.
dz: 第一位白金汉公爵乔治·维利耶斯被约翰·费尔顿刺杀.
de: George Villiers, the first Duke of Buckingham, is assassinated by John Felton.

t: 清教徒定居塞勒姆，该地区成为马萨诸塞湾殖民地的一部分。
te: Puritans settle Salem, which became part of Massachusetts Bay Colony.
dz: 清教徒定居塞勒姆，该地区成为马萨诸塞湾殖民地的一部分。
de: Puritans settle Salem, which became part of Massachusetts Bay Colony.

t: 拉罗谢尔之围以胡盖诺特人14个月后投降而告终.
te: The Siege of La Rochelle ends with the surrender of the Huguenots after fourteen months.
dz: 法国宗教之战:拉罗谢尔之围以胡盖诺特人14个月后投降而告终.
de: French Wars of Religion: The Siege of La Rochelle ends with the surrender of the Huguenots after fourteen months.
